name: Library
intro: Library is where everything you make in SmartVideo is saved automatically, along with your uploads. Here's how to find, preview and reuse your work.

features.filters-and-counts: The filter buttons are All, Images, Videos, Audio and Uploads. Most show a count, so you can narrow a long history down to just the kind of file you want.
features.search-and-sort: Search by prompt or model to find an item by what you typed or which model made it. The sort menu switches between newest first and oldest first.
features.quick-actions: Hover over an item to reveal four small buttons: Download, Copy prompt, Save to Content, and Delete. You can act on a result without opening it.
features.preview: Click an image or video to open a larger view with its prompt, model and date, plus a Download action. Audio plays right inside the card.
features.uploads-and-use-in-studio: The Uploads filter lists the files you uploaded. Hover and choose Use in studio to send one to a studio like Image Studio or Cinema Studio, with no re-uploading.

outro: That's Library. Search your history, copy a prompt that worked, and save your best results to Content.
